en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a grand, ornate building in an urban square. The text is in Hungarian and German, suggesting a bilingual region. The building is labeled as 'Pécsi Takarékpénztár palotája,' which translates to the Savings Bank Palace of Pécs. The architecture is elaborate, with classical details and a prominent roofline, indicating a late 19th or early 20th-century style. There is additional printed text on the left and top right sides in red ink.
